questions.subject: GERMAN
questions.topic: Apologising for a delay at work

stimulus.body: Betreff: Verzögerung bei der Lieferung. Hallo Frau Keller, die Lieferung der Ersatzteile verzögert sich um zwei Tage. Es tut mir leid, dass wir den ursprünglichen Termin nicht halten konnten. Der neue Termin ist Donnerstag, der 14. Juni. Mit freundlichen Grüßen, J. Fischer

questions.stem: Im Arbeitsblatt: Read the workplace message above: the writer gives a reason for a delay, expresses regret, and names a new date. Is that apology adequate by the standard such messages are normally judged by, and why?

options.text: No, apologies are unnecessary. — Antwort aus dem Text
options.misconception: denies value

options.text: Yes, it includes regret and a new date. — Antwort aus dem Text
No, blame must be shifted. — Antwort aus dem Text
options.misconception: wrong approach

options.text: No, vagueness is better. — Antwort aus dem Text
options.misconception: misjudges clarity

questions.explanation: An adequate workplace apology acknowledges the problem ('es tut mir leid') and gives the reader something concrete to rely on (the new date, Thursday 14 June). Saying apologies are unnecessary (A) ignores the disruption; shifting blame (C) would make the message defensive rather than accountable; and vagueness (D) would remove the very information the recipient needs. Regret plus a specific new date is the standard form.
questions.hint: Check for regret and a concrete replacement date.
